title: Quartic High-Discriminant Corpus
objective: Create and benchmark a pinned stratified higher-discriminant quartic class-number corpus with exact oracle agreement, reproducible selection, and phase diagnostics

handoff.summary: Pinned 36 LMFDB quartics across all 3 signatures, 3 absolute-discriminant bands from 1e5 to 1e8, and 4 class-group shapes. Each record has an unconditional Sage 10.9/PARI 2.17.1 oracle and replayable provenance. Added one ordinary Python runner for identical Sage.js and Sage/PARI scalar/group boundaries with exact failures, retained-state shape, phase, and resource diagnostics. The 12-field conditional smoke tier completed 8/12 under default Sage.js caps (successful geometric mean 7.375s) versus 12/12 for Sage/PARI (5.432ms). Two Sage.js positives took 92.326s and 263.639s although relation phases were only 1.326s and 2.130s; both uniquely constructed a post-saturation scalar projection. One exact diagnostic took 298.867s and another exceeded a 420s external bound. A representative retained conditional scalar took 2.885s, first group materialization 4.568s, and independent group verification 8.973s.
risks: The holdout tier is intentionally unmeasured; do not inspect it until a quartic optimization policy is frozen on smoke and tune.
Warm timing requires an already populated Sage.js generated-artifact cache. Immediately after a clean lane build the first smoke scalar was 67.136s; the identical next process was 2.452s.

pnpm test:changed passed four complete unit batches, then an unrelated Chromium Wasm test failed because dist/wasi-runtime.mjs returned 404; this lane changes only benchmark scripts and a JSON fixture.
next_steps: Use smoke fields 4.2.3324000.1 and 4.2.32230080.1 as slow positives for eliminating post-saturation scalar proof-object construction, with 4.2.778975.1 and 4.2.31647788.1 as fast controls.

Preserve one resumable authenticated arithmetic core through class_number, optional class_group materialization, and detached verification; do not widen resource caps to hide the current incomplete cases.
After the policy is frozen on smoke, run the 12 tune fields and only then inspect the 12 holdout fields.
